raw_meta_yaml:
{% set version = "2.1.0" %}
{% set posix = 'm2-' if win else '' %}

package:
  name: r-glmtrans
  version: {{ version|replace("-", "_") }}

source:
  url:
    - {{ cran_mirror }}/src/contrib/glmtrans_{{ version }}.tar.gz
    - {{ cran_mirror }}/src/contrib/Archive/glmtrans/glmtrans_{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 5a9ce5da34817741d3aea63339e4f0fe7feb8ff0bdb731790ef2ce934f5d405b

build:
  number: 1
  noarch: generic
  rpaths:
    - lib/R/lib/
    - lib/

requirements:
  build:
    - {{ posix }}zip               # [win]
  host:
    - r-base
    - r-glmnet
    - r-ggplot2
    - r-foreach
    - r-doparallel
    - r-caret
    - r-assertthat
    - r-formatr
  run:
    - r-base
    - r-glmnet
    - r-ggplot2
    - r-foreach
    - r-doparallel
    - r-caret
    - r-assertthat
    - r-formatr

test:
  commands:
    - $R -e "library('glmtrans')"           # [not win]
    - "\"%R%\" -e \"library('glmtrans')\""  # [win]

about:
  home: https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=glmtrans
  license: GPL-2.0-only
  summary: Transfer Learning under Regularized Generalized Linear Models.
  license_family: GPL2
  license_file:
    - {{ environ["PREFIX"] }}/lib/R/share/licenses/GPL-2

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - conda-forge/r
    - mlondschien
